objective: Test whether graph- and geology-conditioned learning predicts portable tangent-SDF cave anatomy across 12 whole-cave development folds, then calibrate without training on two validation caves and perform one sealed confirmation

source_policy.split_unit: entire cave system and acquisition campaign

context_knn_mean.aggregation: inverse-distance mean with equal total weight per cave source

conditional_empirical.sampling: seeded equal-source then inverse-distance neighbor draw

spatial_transformer.family: graph-context transformer with shared convolutional tangent-plane decoder
spatial_transformer.output: one 33x33 signed-distance mean plane per graph token

graph_rectified_flow.family: conditional rectified flow over correlated low-resolution tangent-plane residuals
graph_rectified_flow.conditioning: frozen spatial-transformer graph hidden state plus diffusion time
graph_rectified_flow.noise: seeded Gaussian field smoothed at registered 2D scales
graph_rectified_flow.role: stochastic residual around the deterministic spatial-transformer mean

training.mean_loss: confidence-weighted smooth-L1 SDF plus boundary-weighted sign BCE plus finite-difference gradient loss
training.context_standardization: training folds only with 0.05 scale floor
training.source_sampling: equal patch count per training cave per step
training.target_quantization_decode: symmetric int8 values times per-token scale

compilation.calibration: one global zero-level offset and one flow temperature selected on Faux Monnayeurs only after development cross-validation

anatomy: boundary Chamfer distance in plane pixels

development_gate.learned_anatomy_win: best learned model beats both non-neural baselines on the registered aggregate anatomy score in at least 9 of 12 whole-cave folds
development_gate.compiled_morphology: best learned model passes the three-of-four and negative-mean-log morphology rule in at least 9 of 12 folds
development_gate.compiled_volume: median raw volume ratio in [0.8, 1.25] in at least 9 of 12 folds
development_gate.compiled_shape: mean equal-volume IoU no more than 0.02 below the strongest baseline
development_gate.safety: protected-route survival 1.0 and all outputs finite
development_gate.diversity: global and per-family lower bound passes without target-volume access

promotion.sealed_confirmation: both newly sealed caves evaluated once with no post-unseal tuning
promotion.failed_sealed_policy: retain development result and reject CW7 promotion; never tune on sealed geometry

claim_limit: named-source anatomy generalization study; no population realism, speleogenesis recovery, or production claim
